notes: Generated by `npm run contracts:generate` from src/domain/tax/returns.ts; do not edit by hand.
input is {sold, request}: the invoice line as sold and the quantity being returned (integer thousandths).
expected.result is the tax-engine line input the return becomes. A key absent from it means undefined (no discount, no hsnCode); a port must treat absent and null alike.
supplyCategory is copied from the sold line and must survive: a credit note reverses the supply it was issued against.
expected.error means the reference rejected the request with that error code; a port must reject too.

cases.name: return part of a line with no discount
return part of a discounted line scales the discount
bill discount share is scaled with the line discount
scaled discount that lands on .5 rounds away from zero
whole return keeps the full discount exactly
a exempt line stays exempt on the return
a nil_rated line stays nil_rated on the return
a non_gst line stays non_gst on the return
a sale with no HSN code returns with none
more than was sold is refused
